verdict.rationale: Paxos documents API credentials (Client ID and Secret) whose allowed scopes can be set to limit access to specific API endpoints. It also uses OAuth 2 client credentials, which gives an agent its own least-privilege credential. The evidence is a brief docs summary rather than an in-depth guide. Missing for 10: detailed scope catalog and granularity, documented credential rotation/revocation and expiry controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API credentials using Client ID and Secret. Set allowed scopes to access specific API endpoints.
Paxos APIs use OAuth 2 with the client credentials grant flow.
